# Getting help

Bibalak is free and open source under `AGPL-3.0-or-later`. Help comes from
the people who build and use it, through the channels below.

| You want to…                             | Go to                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Learn how a feature works                | The [user guide](../docs/guides/user-guide.md) and the [install guide](../docs/guides/install.md) |
| Ask a question or share a study workflow | [Discussions](https://github.com/crrrowz/bibalak/discussions)                                                      |
| Report a bug you can reproduce           | [Issues](https://github.com/crrrowz/bibalak/issues) — search first, then use the bug template                      |
| Suggest a feature                        | [Issues](https://github.com/crrrowz/bibalak/issues) with the feature template                                      |
| Report a security problem                | **Never in public.** Follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md)                                       |

## Before you open an issue

- Update to the [latest release](https://github.com/crrrowz/bibalak/releases/latest); the
  problem may already be fixed.
- Note your operating system, the Bibalak version (**Settings → About**) and
  the exact steps that lead to the problem.
- Never attach your collection or a deck you do not own. A small sample deck
  that shows the problem is enough.

## Response times

Bibalak is maintained by a small team. Issues are triaged weekly; security
reports are answered first.
